[[File:This is Going to Sting menu.jpg|thumb|400px]] '''This is Going to Sting '''is a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Scorponok]] that ran from November 1 to December 6. == Overview == == Changes/Rewards == == Chapter 1 - Extermination== ===Bug Bytes === Part 1 *[[Marissa Faireborn]]: ''Optimus Primal? I have an issue that could a Maximal scan.'' *[[Optimus Primal]]: ''Rhinox and I are just on patrol. What needs investigating?'' *Marissa Faireborn: ''Teletraan is showing mysterious readings on a recent arrival from the quadrant you originated from.'' *[[Rhinox]]: ''Are they displaying as Maximal or Predacon?'' *Marissa Faireborn: ''I don't know, brainwave scans are bouncing all over.'' *Optimus Primal ''Hopefully we caught some luck and they are an ally...or even a Protoform.'' *Marissa Faireborn: ''Sending last known location. Whoever it is, they're on the move.'' Part 2 *Marissa Faireborn: ''Sorry, but the signal is just static from here.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Not the strongest start, but we will see what we can track from the ground.'' *[[Kickback]]: ''Trying to find someone-one?'' *Rhinox: ''We're looking for a Maximal compatriot. You seen anyone hopping by?'' *Kickback: ''Why should I help you-you? What's in it for me-me?'' *Optimus Primal: ''We are all on the same team here Kickback. We are just trying to keep this new Bot safe.'' *Kickback: ''You say team, but not everyone team player-player. The insect Bot that passed wasn't even an Insecticon-con.'' *Rhinox: ''Insect? That usually means Predacon!'' Part 3 *Kickback: ''You got one byte of information as a freebie, bit no more-more!'' *Rhinox: ''Just tell us who you saw and I'll try not to give in to my temptation to swat you.'' *Kickback: ''You catch more flies with honey-honey!'' *Rhinox: ''Who you calling "Honey"''? *Optimus Primal: ''I believe he is looking for a bribe, Rhinox.'' *Rhinox: ''I'm a bit light on Energon Goodies right now, how about I pay you with a sparring lesson?'' *Kickback: ''Sounds like a poor offer-offer. If I can't have a bribe, I'll just take a bite out of your hide-hide!'' ===Old Friends=== Part 1 *Rhinox: ''Wish we got more intel, insect form doesn't exactly narrow the field. Could be Inferno, Tarantulas, Blackarachnia, Cicadacon, Rampage...'' *Optimus Primal: ''Some of those bots are arachnids, not insects. Also, I believe Rampage is a crab.'' *Rhinox: ''I doubt Kickback was aware of the subtle distinctions. Too many legs an all of them if you ask me.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Well whoever it is, hopefully we can show them some reason.'' *Rhinox: ''Reason wasn't a high function in the Pred's operating system. But we can try.'' Part 2 *[[Waspinator]]: ''Apebot and Hornbot! Come to also mock Wazzzpinator?'' *Rhinox: ''What's the big buzz about Hive Head?'' *Waspinator: ''Mocked! No one izzz friend to Wazzzpinator! Even other Predacon pretended to not remember me!'' *Optimus Primal: ''Apologies, I assure you we are here to help. Who did you see?'' *Waspinator: ''He wazzz a very loyal Predacon. Wazzzpinator though Scorponok wazzz gone but...'' *Optimus Primal: ''SCORPONOK? The same Scorponok who stung me with a Cyberbee and made me turn on my most trusted allies when I first arrived here?'' *Waspinator: ''Uhhh...maybe?'' Part 3 *Optimus Primal: ''This is important Waspinator, where did Scorponok go?'' *Waspinator: ''NO! Wazzzpinator will win back old friend by protecting him!'' *Rhinox: ''Why are you sticking out your neck out for Scorponok? He was loyal to Megatron, not to you.'' *Waspinator: ''Wazzzpinator so lonely! Very few Botzzz like me! How are there TWO Bumblebeezzz here and neither one izzz a bug?!'' *Rhinox: ''I could have sworn at least one of them was.'' *Optimus Primal: ''A common misconception.'' *Waspinator:
''ENOUGH MOCKING! WAZZZPINATOR TERRORIZE!''
== Chapter 2 - Extinction == ===Him King=== Part 1 *[[Scorponok]]: ''Do THIS, do THAT, join ME, remember THIS...'' *''Why is everyone on this planet so creepy, crawly and crazy?'' *''I just need to get get my bearings. A familiar landmark will remind me where I am...or maybe who In am.'' *''Also, I should probably stop talking to myself...'' *''...but I do enjoy the conversation.'' Part 2 *[[Grimlock]]: ''What little Snap Claw doing on Grimlock's turf?'' *Scorponok: ''I-I remember you!'' *
''YOU'RE A TRAITOR!''
*Grimlock: ''What? Me most loyal Dinobot that Autobots ever see!'' *Scorponok: ''Exactly! Dinobot! You betrayed our friends and sided with our enemies!'' *Grimlock: ''This happen before. Grimlock not THE Dinbot. Me am KING of Dinobots! Best Dinobot if you ask me! Go on! ASK!'' *Scorponok: ''You make no sense, Dinobot!'' *Grimlock:
''ME MAKE PERFECT SENSE! YOU JUST NOT LISTENING!''
Part 3 *Scorponok: ''We crashed, and you wasted no time in turning on your shipmates!'' *Grimlock: ''Grimlock no turn! Me think you took hit to hard-drive in crash you talk about.'' *Scorponok: ''That was years ago! Then the moon wasn't a moon...and it tried to blow up the planet we were on! I remember that!'' *Grimlock: ''So, now is your turn for not sense making?'' *Scorponok: ''I'm going to rip you apart Dinobot!'' *Grimlock: ''Ah! Fighting! THAT Grimlock understands!'' ===The Traitor=== Part 1 *Scorponok: ''...Dinobot was a LOT bigger than I remember.'' *Waspinator: ''FRIEND! Wazzzpinator has found you after fighting Maximalzzz for your honor. They let me go when they were done hitting me!'' *Scorponok: ''How do you know they let you go, and aren't just following you?'' *Waspinator: ''Oh...uhh...Wazzzpinator may have mizzzcalculated.'' *Scorponok: ''Is Megatron here? I remember that name. I think he'd know what to do!'' *Waspinator: ''MANY Megatronzzz are here! Wazzzpinator will inform one that you're coming!'' *Scorponok: ''Wait! Where do I go?!'' *''and...I'm back to talking to myself.'' Part 2 *[[Dinobot]]: ''Scorponok, finally slimed your way to a new world?'' *Scorponok: ''Wait, didn't we just do this?'' *Dinobot: ''I was looking for the wretched waste of a spark who was screaming my name across the blasted wasteland. Imagine my surprise to find out it was you!'' *Scorponok: ''Surprises must me contagious! Because, I JUST scrapped you!'' *Dinobot: ''You're living a fantasy! You are an honorless pain in my tail that I shall remove.'' *Scorponok: ''Could you hold off on the removing? I need to clear my head.'' Part 3 *Dinobot: ''That seems like an adequate time for a small head like yours to clear. I wouldn't want you to claim this wasn't a fair fight.'' *Scorponok: ''I'm remembering enough...or maybe too much? I remember lava, ancient worlds,...or was it future worlds. I somehow remember being a giant, but I'm not sure that was even me.'' *Dinobot: ''Enought chatter Scorponok, let us settle this like warriors! Dinobot MAXIMIZE!'' *Scorponok: ''Now that finally sounds familiar! Scorponok TERRORIZE!'' == Chapter 3 - Revolution == ===Loyalty is Rare=== Part 1 *Rhinox: ''The tracker we put on Waspinator is active. Guess he's useful after all.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Every Bot on this planet has a purpose. Some do not just fulfill their purpose intentionally.'' *Rhinox: ''Downside is he's a buzzing blur, tracker is giving me a wide area not a precise location. Wish we had someone to scout.'' *[[Cheetor]]: ''Did someone say a stunningly speedy scout could be of service?'' *Rhinox: ''For Primus sake! Have you just been waiting in the shadows for a proper cue?'' *Cheetor: ''You look a lot faster when you have a split second timing like me, big guy!'' *Optimus Primal: ''Cheetor, run ahead and see if you can make contact with Scorponok then report back.'' Part 2 *[[Megatron]]: ''Where are you going in such a hurry, my furred and furrowed friends?'' *Rhinox: ''We ain't friends Megatron. Possibly occasional co-workers till we can get off of New Quintessa.'' *Optimus Primal: ''We are tracking a dangerous new arrival, it would be advisable to assist to allow us to pass.'' *Megatron: ''A little wasp told me this arrival is a true loyalist to the Decepticon cause. Such a precious commodity should be protected.'' *Rhinox: ''Not the team building we're looking to do here Megatron.'' *Megatron: ''You focus every aspect of this world on yourselves. It is time for more brutal leadership.'' Part 3 *Optimus Primal: ''Megatron, there are no sides on this world. Join us and we may hope to restore some sort of order to this constantly expanding war.'' *Megatron: ''Join you? No. Bring forward a new age of Decepticons? Yes!'' *Rhinox: ''Sooner or later, all of you Megatrons start sounding the same.'' *Megatron: ''In the end we both want the same thing: balance. I need loyal soldiers to enforce the balance.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Balance is not the elimination of all who oppose you.'' *Megatron: ''That is your opinion, but I doubt you can present a more appealing argument.'' *Optimus Primal: ''You prefer actions to words? Well, that's just Prime.'' ===Lead or Be Led=== Part 1 *Cheetor: ''Contact has been made Optimus!'' *Optimus Primal: ''Good, were you detected as you observed the target?'' *Cheetor: ''Oh Ok...I may have had a loose understanding of "Contact". I just rushed by and unloaded a laser yolley. Contact made.'' *Optimus Primal: ''That may be contrary to the diplomacy we were hoping to exhibit.'' *Rhinox: ''Is that what we've been doing? A lot of fights for diplomats.'' *Cheetor: ''Scorponok has been forgetful lately, maybe he'll forget this too.'' *Scorponok:
''MAXIMALS!''
*Cheetor: ''He probably remembers.'' Part 2 *Scorponok: ''Would everyone just leave me alone!'' *Optimus Primal: ''Scorponok, I know we have had more than our share of differences, but I can put those aside. Just calm down and listen to us.'' *Scorponok: ''I don't even know who's in charge here any more, how am I supposed to take orders without a chain of command?'' *Cheetor: ''It isn't like that here Scorponok, the war has changed. We can make our own choices now.'' *Rhinox: ''For the first time since your spark first went online, you can be any Bot you want to be.'' *Waspinator: ''WAZZZPINATOR RETURNZZZ! Scorponok look out! Maximalzzz!'' *Cheetor: ''Your timing is astounding Waspinator.'' *Waspinator: ''OH! Thank you!'' Part 3 *Scorponok: ''If I can choose who I want to be, I choose to be in command.'' *Rhinox: ''The default setting of a Predacon, rush to the closest throne.'' *Scorponok: ''It's easy to judge a thirst for power when you're always in charge, Maximal scum!'' *Waspinator: ''Maximalzzz just ruin our lovely planzzz. Never put real work in, just dezzztroy and leave. Bully Botzzz!'' *Optimus Primal: ''We're not in charge. We are just trying to help every Bot here get home, regardless of previous affiliations of struggles.'' *Scorponok: ''Well I'm starting to feel at home right here and I am done changing my mind. So you can either walk away, or leave as scrap metal!'' == Gallery == This is Going to Sting 1 easy.jpg This is Going to Sting 2 medium.jpg This is Going to Sting 3 hard.jpg This is Going to Sting 4 expert.jpg This is Going to Sting 5 master.jpg This is Going to Sting Chapter 1.jpg This is Going to Sting Chapter 2.jpg This is Going to Sting Chapter 3.jpg This is Going to Sting newsfeed.jpg This is Going to Sting newsfeed banner.jpg This is Going to Sting mail.jpg This is Going to Sting newsfeed.png [[Category:Special Missions]]
